reason: I already have my Notion and a spreadsheet set up exactly how I like them, and I don't earn anything, so another $6 a month isn't happening. I might try the free version, but 5 apps and 10 photos is more than I'd actually use.
objection: Honestly I'd use it for a week and then go back to my own system. I don't want to pay for something just to sit next to Spotify, getting charged while I forget about it.
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull in my existing Notion or spreadsheet so I didn't have to start over, and I actually kept using the free version for a full month.
